title: kbext.py rehearse takes a planted fork and a group overlay from one upstream ext tag to the next and reports no conflict, no shipped file edited and every extender verified
goal: kbext.py rehearse --upstream URL --from TAG --to TAG --team DIR [--fork] works in temporary directories it removes; it clones the upstream at the first tag with the group's settings and with --fork a planted fork commit adding a group root by kbroot.py add; it takes the second tag with kbgit.py upstream; it prints the conflicting paths, the shipped files the group's setup changed and kbext.py verify's lines; it exits 0 only when there is no conflict, no shipped file changed and every extender verified; --plant builds the upstream from the running checkout's tracked tools as two commits tagged ext-v<API_VERSION> and the next minor; --plant --break makes the second commit remove the ranker point without a major version, which rehearse reports by name with exit 1

clauses.clause: kbext.py rehearse --upstream URL --from TAG --to TAG --team DIR [--fork] works in temporary directories it removes
it clones the upstream at the first tag with the group's settings and with --fork a planted fork commit adding a group root by kbroot.py add
it takes the second tag with kbgit.py upstream
it prints the conflicting paths, the shipped files the group's setup changed and kbext.py verify's lines
it exits 0 only when there is no conflict, no shipped file changed and every extender verified
--plant builds the upstream from the running checkout's tracked tools as two commits tagged ext-v<API_VERSION> and the next minor
--plant --break makes the second commit remove the ranker point without a major version, which rehearse reports by name with exit 1
